title: FCN Quals
content: Forest Conservation Now (FCN) is a Colorado-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2014 that specializes in accelerating forest restoration and building wildfire resilience across the Rocky Mountain region. Since its founding, FCN has treated over 40,000 acres across 12 landscapes, leveraging $18 million in federal, state, and private funding in close partnership with the US Forest Service, Colorado State Forest Service, and county wildfire councils. FCN’s technical team includes 12 specialists—certified silviculturists, prescribed fire managers, and restoration ecologists—supported by two mechanical thinning crews and a Type 6 prescribed fire module, positioning the organization to deliver integrated, science-driven treatments at landscape scale.
